topology_edges.conditional_mechanism: If U.S. employers add jobs, this may contribute to an indication of labor market resilience.
If there are indications of labor market resilience, this may support trends in consumer spending.
If there are trends of negligible earnings growth and higher unemployment, these may counteract indications of labor market resilience.
If household financial constraints are present, these may counteract trends in consumer spending.
If consumer confidence pulls back, this may counteract trends in consumer spending.
If U.S. consumer spending trends accelerate, this may support U.S. retail-sales growth.
If U.S. retail-sales growth is observed, this may influence the overall outcome.
